parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The IDs of instances on which you want to stop the command. You can specify up to 50 instance IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: InvokeId
parameters.description: The command execution ID. You can call [DescribeInvocations](~~64840~~) to query all execution IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
